releaseNotes.title: Release Notes Summary R7.18.0.00
releaseNotes.intro: This release delivers extensive regulatory, functional, and technical enhancements across EBA, ECB, ESMA, SRB, and national reporting modules. Key improvements include updated taxonomies, enhanced allocation logic, new data fields, cross‑module consistency fixes, and expanded support for country‑specific rules. Below is a structured summary of the most impactful changes.

matcher.title: Regulation–Release Note Matcher
matcher.subtitle: Traces every release note to the regulation provisions it affects: evidence-backed links, verbatim-verified quotes from both sources, and a complete audit trail.
matcher.deleteBody: The run's results and audit trail are deleted permanently. The release notes and regulations are not affected.

interpret.title: Interpret
interpret.body: Each release note is restated in regulatory terms – German business terms such as EWB or PWB are translated into the regulation's vocabulary.

retrieve.title: Retrieve
retrieve.body: Hybrid keyword and semantic search over every article, plus provisions that name the note's concepts and the provisions they cross-reference.

adjudicate.title: Adjudicate
adjudicate.body: The model links the note only to retrieved provisions, grades each link direct or indirect and quotes both sources word for word.

verify.title: Verify
verify.body: Every quote is checked verbatim; scope, empowerment clauses, shared concepts and reference chains are tested, with one self-correction round.

review.title: Review
review.body: A second, independent model call challenges every accepted link – confirm, downgrade or reject – and disagreements are escalated to you.

closedSet.title: Closed candidate set
closedSet.body: The model may only link provisions retrieved from the regulation text, by id – it cannot invent articles or paragraphs.

verbatim.title: Verbatim quotes
verbatim.body: Every regulation and release-note quote is matched against the source text; typo-level differences are replaced by the exact wording, anything else is rejected.

scope.title: Scope check
scope.body: The provision's title must apply to the exposures the note concerns (e.g. loans are not 'other non credit-obligation assets').

substantive.title: Substantive provisions only
substantive.body: Empowerment clauses that only mandate technical standards or delegated acts are never accepted as links.

concept.title: Shared regulatory concept
concept.body: A linked paragraph must itself deal with the concept the note changes (e.g. general vs specific credit risk adjustments).

references.title: Reference chains
references.body: Provisions that a linked rule applies 'in accordance with' are followed and either linked or dismissed with a reason.

selfCorrection.title: Self-correction
selfCorrection.body: Failed checks are sent back to the model once with the reasons; links that still fail are rejected and listed.

noForcing.title: No forced links
noForcing.body: A note without a governing provision is reported as 'no link' – after a challenge round when candidates name its concepts.

fourEyes.title: Four-eyes review
fourEyes.body: A second, independent model call challenges every accepted link from the provision text: it confirms, downgrades it to indirect or rejects it; when it rejects every link of a note, the note is escalated as 'Needs review'.

lineageAgent.title: Technical Lineage AI Agent
lineageAgent.subtitle: Derives the column-level lineage of an execution's code by static data-flow analysis, proves it by replaying the code and probing every input column, and documents every column with a grounded, four-eyes-reviewed AI explanation.
lineageAgent.deleteBody: The lineage, the AI documentation and the audit trail of this analysis are deleted permanently. The execution, its code and its dataset are not affected.

log.llm_error: The language model failed in step {step}: {message}
log.model_fallback: Model {model} is not available; continuing with {fallback}

setup.executionsHint: A calculation (code of a cluster applied to its dataset) whose reported figures you want to explain
setup.emptyBody: Run a cluster in the Cluster tab first; every execution can then be analysed here.
setup.figuresHint: The figures whose content the agent explains; everything they are built from is traced
setup.figuresEmpty: Choose an execution to see the figures its code derives.
setup.derivedCount: {count, plural, one {# derived column} other {# derived columns}}
setup.noDerived: This code derives no column, so there is no content to trace.
setup.endOfChain: End of a calculation chain – a typical reported figure
setup.figuresNote: Suggested: the figures at the end of a calculation chain. Choose up to six.
setup.regulationsHint: Optional: indexed regulations in which the agent looks up the provisions behind every rule
setup.regulationsEmpty: No regulation uploaded yet. Upload and index one in the Regulation tab to get a regulatory basis.
setup.regulationsNone: Without a regulation the regulatory basis and its review are skipped.
setup.methodTitle: How the agent builds the content lineage
setup.methodHint: Deterministic facts first; the AI only names, explains and assesses them, and every claim is checked

trace.title: Trace
trace.body: Replays the calculation statement by statement and attributes every value of every column to the statement that wrote it.

compose.title: Compose
compose.body: Turns statements into business rules and cases and measures each one: records, amounts, content paths and segments of every figure.

describe.title: Describe
describe.body: The AI names and defines every business term and states every rule and case in business language; numbers are checked against the code.

regulate.title: Regulate
regulate.body: Searches the regulation within the calculation's framework, links the defining provisions with verbatim quotes and assesses each rule.

review.title: Review
review.body: A second AI reviewer checks every assessment against the quoted provisions (four-eyes principle) and removes links that don't apply.

translate.title: Translate
translate.body: Every AI text is available in English and German.

setup.versusTechnical: How the code moves data: columns, statements, code lines.
setup.versusContent: What a figure means and is made of: business terms, rules and cases, shares of every value, and the regulation behind it.
setup.readyNoFigures: Choose at least one reported figure
setup.notReadyTitle: Choose an execution and its reported figures
setup.notReadyBody: The agent then traces what every figure is made of and where its rules come from.
setup.noLlm: No language model is configured (OPENAI_API_KEY or Azure OpenAI).

progress.title: Content lineage of {cluster}

trace.title: Trace
trace.body: Replay the calculation and attribute every value

compose.title: Compose
compose.body: Rules, cases, content paths and segments

describe.title: Describe
describe.body: Business terms and rules in business language

translate.title: Translate
translate.body: Every AI text in English and German

detail.traceMismatch: replay differs from the stored execution

progress.interruptedBody: The server restarted while this analysis ran. Start it again.

graph.hidden: {count, plural, one {# classification hidden} other {# classifications hidden}}
graph.aboutBody: Read from left to right: source data elements feed business rules, which derive business concepts and finally the reported figures. Provisions above show where the regulation defines a rule. The bar under each term shows how much of its content was delivered by the source and how much was derived.
graph.tipSelect: Click a term, rule or provision to see its definition, its cases with their records and amounts, and its regulatory basis.
graph.tipNavigate: Drag the background to pan, scroll to zoom; hover an edge to see what it carries.
graph.tipMove: Drag a node to rearrange the graph – its connections follow. Arrow keys move the focused node (Shift for bigger steps); Reset layout restores the automatic arrangement.

edge.value: Its value goes into the result
edge.selector: Decides which case of the rule applies

graph.figureLine: {present} of {records} records carry a value · {paths} content paths
graph.nulled: {count} source values were not numbers ({examples}) and were treated as missing.
graph.quoteVerified: Quote verified verbatim in the regulation
graph.quoteRepaired: Quote matched to the exact wording of the regulation

figures.derivedHint: {delivered} values delivered by the source as they are
figures.pathsHint: Distinct chains of cases behind the values
figures.originsHint: Every value of the figure is either delivered by the source system or derived by one case of its rule.
figures.deliveredHint: The source delivered the value; the rule only fills values that are missing.
figures.pathsDescription: Each path is one chain of business cases that produced values of the figure – from the figure back to its inputs. The largest paths come first; click a record to follow it.
figures.segmentsHint: The figure broken down by the classifications of the records.
figures.recordsHint: Follow one record: how each value of the figure came about, with the values it used.
figures.recordsHintLimited: The first {shown} of {total} records can be traced here.
figures.recordEmpty: Choose a record on the left (or an example of a content path) to see the derivation of its value.
figures.deliveredKept: delivered by the source and kept

glossary.termsHint: Every business term the reported figures are built from, with its definition, its content and its regulatory basis.
glossary.rulesHint: Each rule derives one business concept; its cases are the situations the calculation distinguishes, with the records and amounts each one produced.
glossary.whenWhat: When it applies – what it yields

regulation.skippedTitle: No regulatory basis in this analysis
regulation.skippedNone: No indexed regulation was selected for this analysis. Upload a regulation in the Regulation tab and select it when you start a new analysis.
regulation.intro: For every business rule the agent searched the selected regulations within the framework of the calculation, linked the provisions that define the concept or prescribe the rule, quoted them verbatim (checked against the regulation text) and assessed the implemented rule. A second reviewer checked each assessment.
regulation.quoteVerified: Verified verbatim in the regulation text
regulation.quoteRepaired: Matched to the exact wording of the regulation ({similarity} % similar)
regulation.unverified: The AI proposed provisions, but none of its quotes could be verified in the regulation text, so no link is shown.
regulation.noBasis: No provision of the selected regulations governs this rule.
regulation.dropped: {count} proposed quote(s) were not verbatim and were dropped.

verification.checksHint: Deterministic checks of the content and the AI texts
verification.checksIntro: Everything the agent states is checked: the content against the stored execution, the AI texts against the code, every quote against the regulation.

replay.title: Replay reproduces the stored execution
replay.pass: The replayed calculation matches the stored execution in all {cells} values.
replay.warn: The replay differs from the stored execution in {mismatches} of {cells} values; the content is traced on the replayed result.

attribution.title: Every reported value attributed
attribution.pass: All {values} values of the reported figures are attributed to the source or to a case.

reconciliation.title: Breakdowns reconcile to the totals
reconciliation.pass: Origins, content paths and segments add up to the reported totals of {figures} figure(s).
reconciliation.fail: {differences} breakdown(s) do not add up to the total.

terms.title: Every term named and defined
terms.pass: All {total} business terms have a name and definition.

cases.title: Every case described
cases.pass: All {total} cases are described in business language.

numbers.title: Numbers in rule texts are parameters of the code
numbers.pass: Every number in the rule and case texts appears in the code{corrected, select, true { (after a correction round)} other {}}.
numbers.warn: {issues} text(s) state numbers that are not parameters of the code.

quotes.title: Regulatory quotes verbatim
quotes.pass: All {links} quotes are verbatim in the regulation ({corrected} matched to the exact wording).
quotes.warn: {links} quotes verified; {dropped} proposed quote(s) were not verbatim and were dropped.

unmapped.title: Every category has a parameter
unmapped.pass: Every category met in the data has a parameter.
unmapped.warn: {records} records belong to categories without a parameter.

complete.title: Reported figures complete
complete.pass: Every record carries a value for every reported figure.

translation.title: Texts translated
translation.pass: Every AI text is available in English and German.

verification.findingsIntro: What the content lineage reveals about the figures: gaps, data issues and where the implemented rules depart from the regulation.
verification.noFindings: No findings – the content of the figures is complete and consistent with the regulation.

regulatory_deviation.title: {term}: deviation from the regulation
regulatory_deviation.body: Rule {rule} ({ruleName}) treats a case differently than {references} prescribes.

regulatory_simplified.title: {term}: simplified against the regulation
regulatory_simplified.body: Rule {rule} ({ruleName}) is coarser than {references}; see the regulatory basis for the cases concerned.

figure_missing.title: {term}: values missing
figure_missing.body: {count} of {total} records carry no value for this reported figure.

unmapped_category.title: {term}: categories without a parameter
unmapped_category.body: The parameter table of rule {rule} does not cover {values}; these records get no value.

source_not_numeric.title: {term}: source values are not numbers
source_not_numeric.body: {count} values delivered by the source ({examples}) are not numbers and were treated as missing.

mixed_provenance.title: {term}: delivered and derived values mixed
mixed_provenance.body: {delivered} values are taken from the source as delivered, {derived} are derived by rule {rule}. Delivered values are not recalculated.

filter.title: Records excluded from the figures
filter.body: Line {line} removes {rows} records before the figures are calculated.

no_regulatory_basis.title: {term}: no regulatory basis
no_regulatory_basis.body: {verdict, select, unverified {The AI's proposed provisions for rule {rule} could not be verified.} other {No provision of the selected regulations governs rule {rule} ({ruleName}); it is an internal convention.}}

verification.logHint: Every step the agent took, in order.
